desc: Export an app manifest from an existing app. When called with a manager app token, this method can only export apps that were created by that manager app.

app_id.desc: The ID of the app whose configuration you want to export as a manifest.

app_not_eligible.desc: The specified app is not eligible for this API.

app_not_found.desc: The specified app was not found or has been deleted.

failed_export.desc: Failed to export manifest for given app ID

invalid_app_id.desc: The app ID passed is invalid.

no_permission.desc: User does not have proper permissions.

app_not_owned_by_manager_app.desc: The specified app is not managed by the calling manager app. A manager app can only access apps that it originally created via apps.manifest.create.
